title: Todoom settings
description: App-wide settings shared by every machine: settings.json at the root of the data folder.

background.description: Background image as a base64 image data URL, or null. Anything else makes Todoom ignore settings.json.

language.description: Interface language; null follows the system language.

myWorkColumns.description: Columns shown in « My work », by name (case and accents ignored).

notifications.description: System notifications. Missing fields keep their defaults.

columns.description: Columns that notify when a card arrives, by name. Default: A verifier, Echec, To review, Failed.

due.description: Notify the cards due today, once a day per computer. Default true.

boardTemplate.description: Template a new board starts from: "simple", "dev" (default) or "copy:<board id>".

theme.description: Interface theme; absent means dark. "system" follows each computer's light or dark mode.

compact.description: Compact cards: title, short id and labels as dots. Default false.

snapshotKeep.description: Daily snapshots of the data folder each computer keeps (on its own disk, outside the folder). Default 14.

captureBoard.description: Id of the board the quick capture adds ideas to. Default: a board named « Global », else the first board.

readingCopy.description: Write plain text summaries of the boards into the data folder's « lecture » subfolder, to read them in the Google Drive app on a phone. Default true.

inbox.description: Files dropped into the data folder's « boîte de réception » (from a phone, « Share › Save to Drive ») become cards on the quick capture board, then are removed. Default true.
